subject: Kickoff: Vendor Onboarding & Sustainability Questionnaires - GreenRidge Supplies
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@greenridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier diversity & modern slavery questionnaire — GreenRidge Supplies

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro. Attached is our completed supplier diversity and modern slavery questionnaire (GreenRidge_Supplier_Diversity_Form.pdf). We filled in the ESG section and included the names of our diversity program leads. A couple of quick notes:

- We are a US-based distributor with 18% of suppliers certified as minority-owned.
- Our anti-slavery policy is posted on our website; I included the link in the questionnaire.
- We do not subcontract internationally for core manufactured goods — we source domestically.

Can you confirm what additional documents you need for vendor setup and how Redwood prefers to receive W-9 / COI? Also, what's your expected timeline to get into your PO system?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Head of Procurement
GreenRidge Supplies
procurement@greenridge.com
Attachment: GreenRidge_Supplier_Diversity_Form.pdf (PDF, 24KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier diversity & modern slavery questionnaire — GreenRidge Supplies

Hi Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the detail on supplier programs. I reviewed the questionnaire quickly and it looks good as a first pass.

Next steps from Redwood procurement to get you fully set up in our PO system:
1) Completed vendor setup template (we'll attach the template in a follow-up from Procurement Ops).
2) W-9 (for US vendors) or VAT equivalent if outside US.
3) Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured — minimum coverage limits are in the template.
4) Any SOC / security attestations if you host PII or provide hosted services (separate ask; seems not necessary based on your note).

Marissa (copied) will send the vendor setup workbook and procurement checklist. Vivek — looping you in on COI and any legal review flags.

If you can provide items 2–3 this week we'll aim to create the vendor profile and issue a PO the following week. If anything will take longer, let us know and we can adjust.

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup packet & PO timeline — Redwood procurement checklist

Hi Alex — welcome, and thanks for submitting the questionnaire. I attached the vendor setup workbook we use to collect the information to create a supplier in our ERP (redwood-vendor-setup-template.xlsx). Please complete tabs A (company details) and B (tax and payment info).

Quick checklist and notes:
- Attach a completed W-9 (if US) or W-8 / VAT registration (if non-US) — file name: GRS_W9_Form.pdf or equivalent.
- Certificate of Insurance naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured — see sample requirements in the COI tab.
- Banking details: ACH is preferred. If you need to be paid by wire, include intermediary banking instructions.
- Diversity/self-identification: we will use your questionnaire for our Supplier Diversity program; if you have official certification docs (e.g., WBE/MBE), attach them to accelerate registration.
- PO cadence: once the vendor record is created and documents validated, we can issue a one-time PO within 3 business days. Ongoing POs follow net-30 terms unless otherwise negotiated.

Links & attachments:
- Vendor setup workbook (attached).
- Procurement templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBProcurementTemplates
- DocuSign for onboarding ITOA (if required): https://app.docusign.com/templates/abcd-1234

If you prefer to upload documents to a secure folder rather than email, tell me and I'll send a secure intake link.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-vendor-setup-template.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: Alex Moreno <alex@greenridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup packet & PO timeline — Redwood procurement checklist

Hi Marissa — got the workbook, thanks. A couple items to flag:

- W-9 attached (GRS_W9_Form.pdf).
- COI attached (GreenRidge_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf) — coverage meets the limits listed in your template.
- We don't have formal MBE/WBE certs to submit, but can provide company policy docs if helpful.

I'll fill out the vendor setup workbook and return it by end of day today.

Also — one question on payment terms: you mentioned net-30 by default. For our first delivery we'd like to request net-45 to accommodate an internal financing runway. Is that something we can ask for in the terms?

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Procurement
GreenRidge Supplies
Attachment: GRS_W9_Form.pdf (PDF, 62KB); GreenRidge_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf (PDF, 110KB)

Alex — quick answer on terms: exceptions like net-45 are reviewed by Finance and tied to contract value and risk. For a one-off first PO we can request a special term, but it requires approval and may delay PO issuance by 2–3 business days. If timing is critical, we recommend proceeding with net-30 and revisiting terms for future orders.

Next: once you upload the completed workbook and attachments, I'll route everything through Finance for validation. If all docs are in order, we'll create the vendor record and issue a PO.

I'll mark this thread as procurement:vendor-setup and will update when the vendor record is created.

Cheers,
Marissa
